title: Lost Recall
description:
Lost Recall is puzzle game with skill-based elements. To progress through the level, you'll need to use both your intellect and agility.Use unique abilities of robots
Each of the robots has its own unique ability, which will be necessary to solve puzzles. Use the red robot to destroy objects. Move hard-to-reach crates with the blue robot. Or move heavy objects with the purple one.200 hancrafted levels
Each of the levels presents a different challenge. Some will rely on your intellect, while others will demand dexterity. There are also a few that carry a certain mystery.35 different appearances
While solving puzzles, you'll have the opportunity to unlock new outfits for your robots. Collect them all and choose the ones that fit your style!
description_short: Puzzle game with the addition of skill-based elements. Move, push the objects, solve puzzles, and uncover new mechanics. Use unique abilities of the robots, which will allow you to unlock the next levels.
